status: test-only prototype; production AI fidelity remains pending
method: 8x8 spatial samples per covered pixel; later triangles overwrite earlier samples
memory_scope: Fixed sample storage per covered pixel independent of overlap count; total storage still scales with covered pixels and color components
required_checks: Partial overlap preserves the visible earlier portion
Admission refusal and cancellation return no partial result
One and 1024 overlapping rectangles have equal peak admission and release all credit
Cancellation immediately after admission releases the newly allocated credit
Folded mapping y=4v(1-v) selects the larger-v inverse branch; mean color agrees with the analytic inverse within 0.005
limitations: Synthetic tests do not establish real AI fidelity or speed
Subpixel coverage is approximated by a fixed grid
Production patch traversal currently orders u before v; a v-major grid is available only to the test prototype
Averaging color components before conversion requires investigation for nonlinear color spaces
Real VectorApple and one.ai comparison and full-image memory/runtime measurements are required before integration

real_source_experiment.decision: Do not integrate: no meaningful real-image fidelity gain, higher runtime and memory. Synthetic painter-order correctness does not explain the dominant AI discrepancy.
